# Widgetry

> Widget validation for Python.

# [Aliases](https://linked-h1.test/docs/api/aliases/)

# Aliases

Support for alias configurations.

## AliasPath

A data class used by `validation_alias` to create aliases.

# [Fields](https://linked-h1.test/docs/api/fields/)

# Fields

Defining fields on models.

## Field

Create a field for objects that can be configured.
